description: Control-station visualization for TX12 controls and buoy firmware behavior. Verify channel outputs in the active EdgeTX model.

controls.label: Left stick horizontal
controls.details: Rotate the buoy left or right. Keep centered to arm.

controls.label: Left stick vertical
controls.details: Bottom is 0%; top is 100%. Must be fully down to arm.

controls.label: Right stick horizontal
controls.details: Move left or right. Keep centered to arm.

controls.label: Right stick vertical
controls.details: Move forward or reverse. Keep centered to arm.

controls.label: SE, left outer 3-position switch
controls.details: Move Low then High to arm; sticks must be centered and the power limit at zero. Move away from High to disarm. Low is the immediate stop during Return Home.

controls.label: SB, left inner 3-position switch
controls.details: Low is direct manual. Middle enables compass heading hold while moving with yaw centered. Yaw stick turns; centering captures the new heading. High requests the loaded mission; mission start still requires its Home, boundary, route, GPS, heading calibration, and safety checks.

controls.label: SA, left momentary button
controls.purpose: Set manual Home / Return Home confirm
controls.details: Hold SA while raising SE to arm to capture Home. The buoy saves Home in ESP32 nonvolatile storage, so it survives power cycles. After arming, release both SA and SD; then hold SA and SD together for 1 second to start manual Return Home. Either button alone does nothing. Return Home requires a fresh GPS fix and calibrated heading. SE away from High stops and disarms.

positions.label: Pressed
positions.meaning: Capture Home during arm; hold with SD for Return Home

controls.label: SD, right momentary button
controls.details: Hold SD together with SA for 1 second to start manual Return Home. SD alone does nothing. Release both buttons after arming before the confirmation can be accepted.

positions.label: Pressed
positions.meaning: Hold with SA for Return Home

controls.label: SC, right inner 3-position switch
controls.details: Manual mode only. Low saves/stops the session; Middle records science without audio; High records science with audio. Mission mode controls collection automatically.

controls.label: SF, right outer 3-position switch
controls.details: Low or Middle uses buoy Wi-Fi telemetry. High selects MAVLink through the TX Backpack. This switch changes telemetry routing, not buoy control authority.

controls.label: S1, left slider
controls.details: No buoy command is assigned to this slider.

controls.label: S2, right slider
controls.details: No buoy command is assigned to this slider.
